target_customer: Real estate developers and investors seeking development sites
problem: Developers struggle to find sites where a profitable project is buildable and likely to sell.
business_model: Success fee of 1.5 percent on properties sold (per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Required zoning and property data aggregation plus valuation and sale probability models.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on proprietary database and relationships; little evidence of lock in.

market_need_then: YC page claimed 141,000 dollars of revenue in three months and 310,000 dollars in signed term sheets, which is a company claim.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; site says clients prefer a low profile.

pivots.to: Quantitative real estate advisory (Quantierra Advisors LLC)
pivots.why: Not stated; seen on company site

outcome_analysis: Quantierra pitched data driven site sourcing for developers with early revenue claims at YC, but sources show no funding rounds and the current site presents it as a small quantitative real estate advisory firm. It appears to have stayed small as an advisory business with no sourced venture outcome.
notes: YC page lists no founders. Search snippets named Ben Carlos Thypin and Scherezade Momin (Crunchbase) and another named Sandip Trivedi (YC listing), conflicting and not opened, so no founders recorded. Another profile cites different revenue figures (41,000 and 10,000), unverified. Directory data says Active; no funding found. No dated competitor sources found.
